facts.fact: The cemetery occupies the former plantation site on a bluff of the Wilmington River east of Savannah.
facts.excerpt: The peaceful setting rests on a scenic bluff of the Wilmington River, east of Savannah.

facts.fact: It became a private cemetery in1846 and a public cemetery in1907.
facts.excerpt: The site was purchased for a private cemetery in 1846 and became a public cemetery in 1907.

facts.fact: Its entrance is330BonaventureRoad and the grounds exceed100acres.
facts.excerpt: The entrance to the cemetery is located at 330 Bonaventure Road

facts.fact: The original plantation site is named by the city; an attractive landscape does not erase its earlier context.
facts.excerpt: Bonaventure Cemetery was developed on the historically significant site of Bonaventure Plantation.
